subject.title: Group chat context handling can blur which messages are addressed to the current agent

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared per-message target-attribution contract for group history and reply context, with Telegram as the first implementation?
rationale: The fix affects shared history types, plugin/channel boundaries, prompt semantics, and Telegram behavior; previous implementation attempts were closed unmerged and the remaining open PR is only an interim prompt mitigation.

options.title: Approve Typed Metadata Contract
options.body: Define current-agent, other-agent, and ambient target metadata in the shared context/history surface, then implement Telegram with tests and live proof.

options.title: Keep Prompt-Only Mitigation
options.body: Treat the issue as model-behavior guidance and land only prompt/docs wording while leaving durable target metadata out of scope.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Keep this issue as a design tracker while channel-specific issues such as Feishu and Telegram choose their own context-isolation policies.

recommendation.title: Approve Typed Metadata Contract
recommendation.body: Define current-agent, other-agent, and ambient target metadata in the shared context/history surface, then implement Telegram with tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal points to repeated work on group prompts, history helpers, and Telegram context paths.
